title: feat(plugin-auth): a new organization takes its creator's default currency (#25495)
body:
Fixes #25495

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What this does

A new organization now gets `localization.currency` from its creator's language or region. The maintainer's ruling, as the card quotes it: 「#8345：环境的默认币种，应该在objectstack 仓库吧」「同意乙」.

- **Where the value comes from.** First the creator's stored `sys_user.locale`. If that is not set, the creating request's `Accept-Language`, read with the platform's one parser (`preferredLocaleFromHeader`). This is the same order `GET /auth/me/localization` uses for the user's language, minus its third rung (the deployment default).
- **The mapping.** The tag's region. A bare language uses the region `Intl.Locale#maximize()` gives it (`zh` maps to CN, `ja` to JP). That region's ISO 4217 currency comes from a checked-in CLDR 48 `currencyData` snapshot (`REGION_CURRENCY`). The provenance block names the package, the file's sha256 and the selection rule. `Intl` has no region-to-currency lookup and no installed dependency carries the table, so nothing was added to the dependency tree.
- **Nothing to derive from means nothing is written.** That covers no stored language, no header, a tag with no country (`es-419`), or a malformed tag. There is no fallback to `default_country: 'US'` or `locale: 'en-US'`.
- **Never over a set value.** The write happens only while the key still resolves from the default (`source: 'default'`). It is the settings service's own `set`, one `tenant` row, the same row `PUT /api/settings/localization` writes. Setup → Localization shows it and can change it.
- **The dev seed** does the same for its admin's workspace, beside the existing time-zone seeding. It reads the host's POSIX locale (`LC_ALL`, then `LC_MONETARY`, then `LANG`). It does not use `Intl`'s default locale, because that answers `en-US` on a host with no locale set. This container is one: `LANG` unset, and `Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().locale` answers `en-US`.
- **The manifest comment** on the `currency` key now says where a new organization's value comes from.

## The seam, measured (dispatch assumptions A1–A3)

- **A1, holds.** `AuthManagerOptions.onOrganizationCreated` exists, and `afterCreateOrganization` calls it with `{ organizationId, userId, name, slug }`. No production code supplied it. AuthPlugin now wraps it after `auth:configure`, so a host's own callback still runs, and runs first. Which of the two sources the seam can see: **both**.
  - The stored locale: through `userId`, read from `sys_user` as a system read.
  - The request's `Accept-Language`: better-auth runs `afterCreateOrganization` inside its endpoint-context `AsyncLocalStorage`, so `tryGetCurrentAuthEndpointContext()` carries the headers. The same accessor `auth-manager-database-secret.ts` already uses.

  Case 1 below proves it end to end: no stored locale, only the header, and `CNY` lands.
- **A2, holds.** It is an ordinary tenant-scoped `SettingsService.set`. The tests read `getNamespace('localization', { tenantId })`, which is what the Setup → Localization route returns. They see `{ value: 'CNY', source: 'tenant' }`.
- **A3, NOT MEASURED.** `objectstack-ai/cloud` is not reachable from this session: `add_repo` refused it with "you don't have access". In-repo evidence: `onOrganizationCreated`'s docblock says the cloud control plane supplies it to provision an organization's born-with environment. So cloud's organization creation goes through better-auth `createOrganization`, and the host callback is preserved by the wrapping. Whether a cloud environment runtime's first organization is created through this seam, and not by provisioning, is still unknown. Triage owns that read.

The `organization` plugin factory was not edited. PR #25594 landed on `main` during this run. This branch merged it, and `auth-manager.ts` and `auth-manager-organization-plugin.ts` are untouched by this diff.

## Tests

All results are at head `8bce0422cd`; the reader consolidation `40b9af0e49` re-ran the package suite (3667 passed | 10 skipped) and the four targeted files (115/115). They follow the build closure `pnpm turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/plugin-auth...'` (29/29 tasks).

- `organization-created-default-currency.test.ts`, 9 cases. It boots a real `ObjectKernel` with ObjectQL on SQLite and the real `AuthPlugin`, `SecurityPlugin` and `SettingsServicePlugin`. Organizations are created through the real `POST /organization/create` under the `group` posture, with a fixture `org-scoping` provider.
  - 1: a zh-CN request gives `CNY` (`source: 'tenant'`).
  - 2 and 3: no derivation gives nothing stored and zero currency writes.
  - 4: stored `ja-JP` outranks a zh-CN header and gives `JPY`.
  - 5: `OS_LOCALIZATION_CURRENCY=EUR` is kept, with no write.
  - 6: a host callback runs first and its `GBP` is kept.
  - 7: the dev seed with `LANG=zh_CN.UTF-8` gives `CNY`.
  - 8: the dev seed with `LANG=C.UTF-8` stores nothing.
  - 9: the dev seed leaves an existing tenant value alone.
- `organization-default-currency.test.ts`, 32 cases. The table is all in the `iso_4217_currency` domain. It also covers the mapping, the POSIX env reading, the never-overwrite rule, creator-locale precedence and wrapping order.
- `dev-admin-seed-workspace-timezone.test.ts`: `LC_ALL` / `LC_MONETARY` / `LANG` added to its cleared env, so its "no localization write" cases cannot pick up the new currency write from the machine running them.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test`: Test Files 193 passed (193), Tests 3667 passed and 10 skipped (3677). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck`: exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK`).
- **Ablation**, one run per leg, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with a trap restore. The tests import `AuthPlugin` from source, so no rebuild is involved.
  - Leg A: the request's `Accept-Language` is never read (anchor x1 to x0, blob `2033a70a` to `56a7862a`). Case 1 goes red: 1 failed, 8 passed.
  - Leg B: the `source !== 'default'` guard is removed (blob to `6fd0c02e`). Cases 5, 6 and 9 go red: 3 failed, 6 passed.
  - Restore: blob equals HEAD `2033a70a`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty after each leg.

## Gates

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `40b9af0e49` (and earlier at `8bce0422cd`) derived 74 commands. All 74 ran with exit 0. The `--ran` reconciliation answers: "74 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 74 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 74 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the six touched files: exit 0.
- The repo-wide farm runs in CI on this PR.

## Console check

**Measured** (the dev's addendum on #25495, comment 6383481471; recorded here by the seat). Full workspace build (`pnpm build`, 76/76), and the console at the pinned objectui SHA `2958f17e9c6a` (`pnpm objectui:build`). A fresh showcase stack: `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=group OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL=admin@objectos.ai OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY=invite-only pnpm dev -- --fresh -p 38425`, with the host `LANG` unset. Playwright Chromium, locale `zh-CN`, signed in as the dev admin:

- `POST /api/v1/auth/organization/create` with `Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9` created 上海分公司. `GET /api/settings/localization` there answers `currency {value: CNY, source: tenant}`; the Default Organization (no creator) answers `{value: null, source: default}`.
- In 上海分公司, `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_product`: a new product's `unit_price` (dynamic mode, no code) renders `¥1,234.50`, and every seeded price renders with `¥`. The same list in the Default Organization renders plain `29.99`, `99.00` ….
- Setup → Localization (`/_console/apps/setup/system/settings/localization`) shows 默认货币 = CNY with the 租户 (tenant) source badge.

## Acceptance notes

- **The `single` posture's Default Organization gets no currency.** It is created at boot by `ensureDefaultOrganizationExists`, which has no creator. The first admin is bound to it later and never passes through `organization/create`. So on the most common self-host path (`os serve`, first sign-up), the organization still has no currency. Only the dev seed fills it. That is outside the seam this card names. Carrier: none. Raised for triage as a product question: should the Default Organization take its first owner's currency when the owner is bound?
- `service-settings` changes only a code comment, so it has no changeset entry. `plugin-auth` takes `patch`.
- CLDR 48 maps `BG` to `EUR` (from 2026-01-01). The snapshot records that as CLDR has it.
- Precedence follows the card: a stored `sys_user.locale` of `en` gives `USD`, even when the browser sends `zh-CN`.
